# Sparse Collocation Benchmark Spike (Provisional)

## Model and Transcription

F03 (#11787) adds a bounded, **synthetic** sparse inverse-dynamics collocation
spike and benchmark receipt. It does not solve the native full-body golf swing.
The known one-coordinate truth plant is

$$
m\ddot q+c\dot q+kq=\tau, \qquad m>0,\ c,k\ge0.
$$

Units are SI: the synthetic rotary $q$ is in radians, $\dot q$ in rad/s,
$m$ denotes rotary inertia in kg m², $c$ is in N m s/rad, $k$ is in
N m/rad, and $\tau$ is in N m. This is a mathematical rotary fixture, not a
calibrated anatomical joint. Inputs are held constant over each interval,
in accord with the exact applied-input ZOH contract.

For $h_k=t_{k+1}-t_k$, midpoint inverse dynamics and kinematics are enforced
as hard sparse equalities:

$$
\frac{q_{k+1}-q_k}{h_k}-\frac{v_{k+1}+v_k}{2}=0,
\quad
m\frac{v_{k+1}-v_k}{h_k}
+c\frac{v_{k+1}+v_k}{2}
+k\frac{q_{k+1}+q_k}{2}-u_k=0.
$$

The initial $(q_0,v_0)$ is fixed. The decision vector contains all later
positions, velocities and interval inputs. Each defect row touches only its
two neighboring nodes and one input; `defect_jacobian()` returns the exact
sparse Jacobian. Bounded `trust-constr` solves the quadratic observation,
effort and rate objective subject to both equations, hard input bounds and
hard input-rate constraints. No contact/grip or manifold dynamics is inferred
from this linear fixture.

## Independent Forward Check and Benchmark Receipt

After optimization, the candidate's post-solve ZOH inputs are applied to a
fresh initial state by adaptive RK45 integration. That forward path is separate
from midpoint collocation. The receipt reports optimizer convergence,
maximal physical dynamics defect, input/rate violations, node objective,
fresh forward state gap and observation RMSE as distinct values. A deliberately
coarse stiff-plant case has small collocation defect yet exceeds a predeclared
fresh replay gap; node feasibility cannot be promoted to independent replay.

`benchmark_backends` accepts named backend adapters, predeclared starts and
explicit replay, observation, bound and per-defect-kind feasibility limits.
Each attempt records cold or warm status, failures, solve time, independent
post-solve replay time, total callback time and Python-tracked peak allocation
on a named host with Python/NumPy/SciPy versions. Summaries retain p50/p95
solve, replay and total times, and elapsed time through the first accepted
attempt. The total timer includes callback setup, derivative construction,
solve, fresh replay and receipt assembly. The existing shooting adapter's
solver timer includes its internal unsegmented replay; the separately timed
replay is a second fresh post-solve rollout. These component timers therefore
cover different internal work. The total timer excludes external data
preparation, private capture calibration, native resource loading and artifact
export; therefore it is **not** a full time-to-accepted-capture-match result.
Python allocation is not process RSS, native library allocation, GPU memory or
a system-wide peak. No production backend is selected from this fixture.

The synthetic test also runs the repo's existing `fit_multiple_shooting` on
the same second-order truth plant, horizon and target. Its adapted candidate
uses one constant torque parameter, while sparse collocation uses one torque
per interval. The receipt records input degrees of freedom and distinct
`shooting_state` versus `midpoint_inverse_dynamics` defect kinds so those
numbers cannot silently be compared as the same constraint. The common
post-hoc objective and fresh forward error are comparable fixture diagnostics;
the different input parameterizations and solver objectives preclude declaring
a winning production backend. Crocoddyl/FDDP remains the native FDDP authority.
A future native comparison must use the same model, actual input kind,
observation mask/covariance, horizon, hard bounds, starts and resource budget,
then pass the early F06 independent native replay validator.
It must bind dynamics/contact/integrator/actuator/restart identities and report
all rejected starts. D02's private protocol must be frozen before any capture
fitting. This chapter and its associated calculation-registry entry are
provisional; no six-engine, own-contact, muscle or real-capture qualification
is implied.

Reproduce the synthetic derivative and rollout checks with
`python -m pytest tests/unit/motion_matching/test_sparse_collocation_spike.py -q`.
